decisions.summary: Nucleated seating with no start_tree corridor, no access_exit, no reserve_field_corridor; exit_bearing kept as a ground test that refuses a margin; an empty AccessTree for bookkeeping; SeatRegion._reached flooded from a private anchor past the seat band on the way-out bearing, never painted, reserved or recorded
decisions.why: FR-001 removes both reservations; the bearing test is the spec's edge case and Decisions Recorded (asked of the margin, answered by ground, nothing reserved); the anchor is the mechanism FR-002 names (ground connected to open country on the way-out side). It stays within only while it refuses no seat: painted into buildable or the registry it would be the strip again.

decisions.summary: lay_the_ways moves to stage_track after the connector (stage_track directly follows stage_homesteads in driver STAGES); ways join the connector; corridor reservations made when the ways are laid, wood seats still at the end of the homesteads stage
decisions.why: FR-003 verbatim: the track out first from the cluster's edge once the last house stands, then each household's way joined to it. Wood seats are not ways.

decisions.summary: The field path is left to the web (settle_field, field_runs); an unreached field is fixed in the web's search, never by a reservation
decisions.why: FR-003's 'then the field path as the web lays it' and FR-004's field reached; it forbids the reservation the GM asked removed.

decisions.summary: Every branch reading access_exit or the field corridor deleted; the row and dispersed forms' fallback becomes the only path
decisions.why: access_exit is written only by start_tree, called only on the nucleated form, so the deletions touch no row village's planned streets (FR-001's parenthetical); removing dead branches is the removal itself.

decisions.summary: Page 0081's drawing page already says houses first with no strip exception; claims citing the strip or field corridor rewritten; owed checks run via claims-triage
decisions.why: Premise checked: the drawing page carries no 'strip' or field-way exception (grep 2026-10-04); the DEVIATION lives only in the code claims. FR-006 is still owed in full under T07: line 33's 'connected to the track out' and 'not close by a way' must be read against the empty-tree seating.
